title: "Iris 数据集分析报告"

# 1. 数据概览

内置 `iris` 数据集包含 150 个观测、5 个变量（4 个测量值 + Species 标签），
3 个物种各 50 条。

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
set.seed(42)
```

```{r overview}
data(iris)
dim(iris)
str(iris)
summary(iris)
```

```{r counts}
table(iris$Species)
```

# 2. 按物种的分组统计

```{r grouped}
sp_mean <- aggregate(. ~ Species, data = iris, FUN = mean)
sp_sd   <- aggregate(. ~ Species, data = iris, FUN = sd)
knitr::kable(sp_mean, caption = "各物种均值（cm）", digits = 3)
knitr::kable(sp_sd,   caption = "各物种标准差（cm）", digits = 3)
```

# 3. 可视化

```{r plots, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(ggplot2)
  p1 <- ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length, color = Species)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linetype = "dashed") +
    labs(title = "Sepal vs Petal Length by Species") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
  p2 <- ggplot(iris, aes(Species, Petal.Length, fill = Species)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = "Petal Length by Species") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
} else {
  plot(iris$Sepal.Length, iris$Petal.Length, col = as.integer(iris$Species),
       pch = 16, xlab = "Sepal Length (cm)", ylab = "Petal Length (cm)")
  legend("topleft", legend = levels(iris$Species), col = 1:3, pch = 16)
  boxplot(Petal.Length ~ Species, data = iris,
          main = "Petal Length by Species", col = 2:4)
}
```

# 4. 线性模型

用萼片长度与宽度预测花瓣长度：

```{r model}
model <- lm(Petal.Length ~ Sepal.Length + Sepal.Width, data = iris)
summary(model)
```

调整后 R² = `r round(summary(model)$adj.r.squared, 3)`，
`Sepal.Length` 系数为正、`Sepal.Width` 系数为负，两者均高度显著
（p < 2e-16），说明花瓣长度随萼片长度增大而增大、随萼片宽度增大而减小。

# 5. K-means 聚类

对 4 个数值特征做 k=3 聚类，并与真实物种标签对比：

```{r cluster}
iris_features <- iris[, c("Sepal.Length", "Sepal.Width", "Petal.Length", "Petal.Width")]
clusters <- kmeans(iris_features, centers = 3, nstart = 25)
knitr::kable(clusters$centers, caption = "聚类中心", digits = 3)
ct <- table(predicted = clusters$cluster, actual = iris$Species)
knitr::kable(ct, caption = "聚类 vs 真实物种交叉表")

best_sp <- colnames(ct)[apply(ct, 1, which.max)]
names(best_sp) <- rownames(ct)
pred_species <- best_sp[as.character(clusters$cluster)]
acc <- mean(pred_species == as.character(iris$Species))
```

最佳映射准确率：**`r round(acc, 3)`**（`r sum(pred_species == as.character(iris$Species))`/150）。
`setosa` 被完美分离（50/50）；`versicolor` 与 `virginica` 各有少量混淆。

# 6. 结论

- 三个物种在花瓣尺寸上差异明显，`setosa` 的花瓣远小于另外两类；
- 花瓣长度可由萼片尺寸较好地线性解释（调整 R² = `r round(summary(model)$adj.r.squared, 3)`）；
- 仅凭 4 个数值特征、无需标签的 k-means 即可还原物种分组，准确率 `r round(acc, 3)`。
